description:
Quickly render one frame of a scene and return it as an image, without making a video. Use it to check framing, colours and labels before render_map.

Highlights countries on real satellite imagery (or an old paper map) with a tracing border, colour fill, glow and label, the look of documentary/explainer YouTube videos.
Write a scene: { "highlights": [{ "country": "India" }] } is a complete one. Add only what the request asks for; defaults look good.
Map requests to fields: a colour -> highlights[].color; "show the flag" -> style "flag"; "rest of the world grey/dark" -> style "highlight"; "just the border" -> style "outline"; "old map / history / parchment" -> basemap "paper"; "from space / the globe / spinning Earth" -> camera "globe"; "zoom in from far away" -> camera "zoom-in"; "travel/tour/go from X to Y" -> camera "fly" with highlights in visiting order; a state or province -> highlights[].region; "Shorts/Reels/TikTok/vertical" -> aspect "9:16"; "mark the capital" -> capital true; "compare countries by <number>" -> data.values with a title.
Borders follow the highlighted country's official view of disputed areas (pov "auto").

at.description: Second to show. Default: the final frame (everything visible).

scene.description: An animated map: one or more highlighted countries, a basemap, a camera move and effects. Needs "highlights" or "data".

aspect.description: 16:9 for YouTube (default), 9:16 for Shorts/Reels/TikTok, 1:1 or 4:5 for feeds.

basemap.description: satellite (default, NASA Blue Marble + Sentinel-2 close up), paper (old parchment map), bluemarble, sentinel.

fill.description: How much of the frame the countries fill. Default 0.72.

from.description: zoom-in only: starting zoom relative to the final shot. Default 0.2.

camera.description: push-in (default, slow drift closer), zoom-in (from a wide view down to the country), globe (spinning 3D Earth that dives down onto the country), fly (visit each highlight in order, flying between them), static.

data.description: Data map: colour countries by a number and show a legend. Can be combined with highlights.

labels.description: Label each country: "name" (or true), "value" (the number with prefix/unit, e.g. "11.4%"), or "both" (name over number). Default none: labels crowd on dense maps.

scheme.description: Colour ramp name or a list of colours from low to high. Default "reds".

duration.description: Seconds. Default 5; 7 for the globe camera; 1 + 3 per country for fly.

blur.description: Soft-focus edges like a camera lens. Default 0. Try 0.6-0.8.

borders.description: Thin borders of neighbouring countries. Default on for paper, off otherwise.

grade.description: Colour grade of the basemap: natural (default), muted, mono.

color.description: Line colour. Any CSS colour ("#c8102e", "rgb(...)") or a name: red, crimson, yellow, gold, orange, green, teal, blue, navy, purple, pink, white, black.

grid.description: Latitude/longitude grid drawn over the sea only.

highlights.description: Countries, states or provinces to highlight, animated one after another (with camera "fly", in the order visited).

color.description: Border colour. Default white (ink on paper). Any CSS colour ("#c8102e", "rgb(...)") or a name: red, crimson, yellow, gold, orange, green, teal, blue, navy, purple, pink, white, black.

glow.description: Glow strength. 0 = none. Default 0.35 for solid, 0.8 otherwise, 0 on paper.

glowColor.description: Glow colour if different from the border. Any CSS colour ("#c8102e", "rgb(...)") or a name: red, crimson, yellow, gold, orange, green, teal, blue, navy, purple, pink, white, black.

border.description: Border line, traced on as the animation starts. false for none.

capital.description: true marks the capital with a pulsing dot and its name; a string marks that city instead ("Mumbai").

color.description: Fill colour. Defaults to a distinct colour per country (yellow for the first "highlight"). Any CSS colour ("#c8102e", "rgb(...)") or a name: red, crimson, yellow, gold, orange, green, teal, blue, navy, purple, pink, white, black.

country.description: Country name ("India", "United States") or ISO code ("IN", "IND"). With "region", narrows which country the region is in.

label.description: Text on the country. Default: its name in capitals. false for none. "\n" starts a smaller second line, e.g. "INDIA\n1.4 BILLION".

labelAnim.description: rise (default), type (typewriter), spread (letters close in), slide, pop.

labelColor.description: Label colour. Default white (ink on paper). Any CSS colour ("#c8102e", "rgb(...)") or a name: red, crimson, yellow, gold, orange, green, teal, blue, navy, purple, pink, white, black.

labelFont.description: "sans" (Montserrat), "serif" (Cinzel), or an installed font family. Default sans, serif on paper.

labelSize.description: Multiplier on the automatic label size (also scales the city name). 0.7 shrinks a label that overflows a small country; 1.3 enlarges. Default 1.

region.description: A state or province instead of a whole country: name ("California", "Maharashtra", "Bavaria") or ISO 3166-2 code ("US-CA", "IN-MH"). capital: true then marks the state capital.

start.description: Second at which this country starts animating. Default: staggered automatically.

style.description: solid: colour tint over the terrain. highlight: the country keeps colour while the rest of the world turns grey. outline: border only. flag: the national flag laid over the terrain.

labelAnim.description: Default label animation for every highlight.

pov.description: Whose official view of disputed borders to draw. "auto" (default) uses the highlighted country's own view; "default" is Natural Earth's; or a code like "ind", "chn", "pak".

scene.title: mapcast scene

name: preview_map
